items.title: Scorpions Captain Named in CAF Team of the Year Shortlist
items.summary: National team captain Musa Barrow has been nominated for the CAF Team of the Year following an outstanding club season in Europe.
items.author: Lamin Ceesay

items.title: Tourism Arrivals Surge 30% as 2024-2025 Season Breaks Records
items.summary: The Gambia Tourism Board reports a record 320,000 tourist arrivals for the 2024-2025 season, a 30% increase driven by new charter routes from Europe.
items.author: Ousman Darboe

items.title: Brikama-Kartong Highway Officially Opened to Traffic
items.summary: President Barrow has officially opened the fully rehabilitated Brikama-Kartong highway, a 45km stretch completed three months ahead of schedule.
items.author: Ousman Darboe

items.title: Agriculture Ministry Distributes Climate-Resilient Seeds for 2025 Rainy Season
items.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture has distributed drought-resistant groundnut and rice seed varieties to 8,000 farming households ahead of the 2025 planting season.
items.author: Ousman Darboe
